items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And the tenor play was named Hays Pillars. And they had a fellow named Charles Pillars. Both of them played in the band.

ctx.x: Where did they get those names from? Were they Mexicans or something?

No, Pillar -- they were black. Jeeter was very light. He was very light. His name was James Jeeter. And the tenor play was named Hays Pillars. And they had a fellow named Charles Pillars. Both of them played in the band. But they stressed -- not like the Benny Moten style, not like Hot Lips was playing or not like McKinney's Cotton Pickers. We had a job in a club so consequently, we had to play a lot of --
